paragraphs.text: Freyalise (fray-uh-LEEZ ) was a half - elven planeswalker from Dominaria .
Although Arkol wrote that Freyalise was a human , he is known to make assumptive mistakes. Freyalise's half-elven heritage was a secret she kept to herself, and not even the elves knew about it.

During the Ice Age , Freyalise was tall and carved in ivory, her features delicate and elongated. Her eyes were almost elven, though her dress was of the human type not seen for hundreds of years. She wore armor woven from hardy winter plants, covered with quilted overlays. Her hair was gathered beneath a great conical helmet that arched back from her head. A great cape of stone feathers sprouted from her shoulders, looking as delicate as a wrapping of fog. She floated effortlessly, her slender form bathed in a nimbus of her light, and her eyes were as deep and as dark as the night skies, and just as merciless. She had a horrible laugh, like that of a hundred bell towers caught in a hurricane.

After the Thaw , Freyalise preferred to dress in the garb of a young elf woman. Her fine green and white gown left her shoulders bare and her arms exposed to the elbow, where long leather gloves extended down to her Fingertips. Her bushy hair stood out from her head, cropped to neck length, and she wore the traditional Llanowar eye patch of brass-colored metal and a single glittering gemstone. Her skin was soft and fair, but its color changed with her mood, shifting from milk white to sunset red as her anger mounted.

Freyalise cared for the Skyshroud deeply, using her magic to protect it without a care for what happened beyond its borders. Though she was not born in the forest, she considered herself a Skyshroud elf. She was known for being stubborn, if not somewhat selfish in her views. However, in her final moments, she saw the greater good she could bring to Dominaria at the cost of her own life.
Freyalise was centered in green mana.

Freyalise was born in Fyndhorn and grew up in one of the tribes of that land. Freyalise came to Storgard as a lone child, seeking refuge from the frigid wastes. The shamans told King Miko that she must have been more than human to have survived, but the High Court would see her only as a daughter of the Stone Council .

At Storgard, Freyalise became a fire mage and the king's court mage. She quickly surpassed her childhood friend Jason Carthalion and tutored him in ice magic, and the two fell in love. After Zilgeth 's death, she was selected as his successor to lead Clan Ruby . When Oriel Kjeldos suggested leaving Storgard, King Miko (under the influence of Tevesh Szat ) ordered that Freyalise and Jason duel. Jason's green magic dealt her a fatal blow and, inspired by his decision to reject black mana, she chose to spurn red and convert to green herself. Her ascension drove her nearly mad, but she was helped by Jodah , the powerful but mortal Archmage Eternal . As a planeswalker, Freyalise temporarily gained wings. Later, she wore an eye patch, had short brown hair, and preferred to float just above the ground rather than stand on it.

Freyalise helped the elves of Fyndhorn and Llanowar survive the Ice Age and, as a result, was deified by them. After the Formation of the Shard of Twelve Worlds , she studied the Shard in search of a way to free the worlds within, and hoped to find the answers during Faralyn 's Summit of the Null Moon . She was tricked, however, since Faralyn wanted to use the energy of a planeswalker's death to escape the Shard. She fought Szat on Azoria and was left for dead after destroying all the islands of the plane. Szat blinded her with Soul Burn .

After this, with the help of Kristina of the Woods , Kaysa , Sir Zaraya , Jodah's mirror and the Ice Cauldron , she cast the World Spell to end the Ice Age. She also armed and instructed Jaeuhl Carthalion on his quest to expel Szat from Dominaria . After she completed the World Spell, she installed the enchantment on Jodah's mirror that would cause Jaya Ballard 's ascension twenty years later.
Freyalise left Dominaria after the Ice Age, 'walking to the rogue plane she had used to break the Shard of the Twelve Worlds with her World Spell.

Freyalise returned to defend Dominaria against the Phyrexian Invasion as one of Urza's Nine Titans . She fought at the battle of Koilos , then transported Eladamri and the Steel Leaf elves to Keld , where the Skyshroud Forest had appeared following the Rathi Overlay . At Eladamri's request, Freyalise cast a spell to protect the forest from the cold of the region before leaving to rejoin the Nine Titans for their invasion of Phyrexia . Of the Nine, only Freyalise, Commodore Guff , Bo Levar , and Lord Windgrace were able to activate the soul bombs they had planted throughout Phyrexia to gut the plane . However, they returned to Dominaria only to find that Yawgmoth himself had crossed over to the plane. Powerless against the Lord of the Wastes, Freyalise returned to Skyshroud and sent an avatar of herself to Llanowar to stand with her elven followers as Yawgmoth descended.

However, Freyalise, along with all of Dominaria, was saved by the activation of the Legacy Weapon, which seemingly destroyed Yawgmoth. As a result, Freyalise and Lord Windgrace were the only two members of the Nine Titans to survive the war. After the Invasion she erected the Martyrs' Tomb and officiated its dedication.

Freyalise resumed her xenophobic stance as she strove to protect Skyshroud from the new threats to the mana-distraught plane of Dominaria. Recent attacks from Gathan warriors and slivers resulted in Skyshroud's continued militant stance toward outsiders. She refused to listen to Teferi about the threat of the time rifts. However, Skyshroud was later invaded by Phyrexians from an alternate reality. Freyalise took control of the local slivers, who were obedient to the strongest leader. This title was soon usurped by the Weaver King , who transported himself to Skyshroud through Venser. In the end, an exhausted Freyalise had a moment of enlightenment, suddenly understanding Teferi's sacrifice and realizing her own somewhat flawed and selfish stance. In an attempt to at least save what could be saved, she attempted to seal the time rift above Skyshroud , brought on by its overlay. She called back the power that she used to protect the forest from its surroundings since the overlay and pulled it into herself. In a huge blast of green and red mana, Freyalise sacrificed herself and Skyshroud to seal the rift.

Freyalise was worshiped by the elves and druids of Fyndhorn as a goddess. Her followers recited the Benediction of Freyalise to exalt and draw strength from her, a chant which was later altered by the Kjeldorans into the Benediction of Kjeld.
Life is warmth, Peace is heat. Safety is strength, In the arms of Freyalise.
Freyalise is all, All are one. Setting moon, Rising sun.
Sun is life, Water is peace, Ice is safety, In the arms of Freyalise.
Freyalise is all, All are one. Setting moon, Rising sun.

Kianon was Freyalise's bonded grizzled wolverine during the Ice Age on on Dominaria . Kianon sacrificed itself to destroy the Woolly Spider Seklistis during Freyalise's duel with Jason Carthalion at Storgard in 2434 AR .
The Celestial Sword , her personal sword, given to Jaeuhl Carthalion before his confrontation with Tevesh Szat.
The Ice Cauldron , used to cast the World Spell .
The Nova Pentacle , taken from Zaraya and given to Jaeuhl.
The Staff of Ice Lords , taken from Kjeld and given to Jaeuhl.
Freyalise was originally given the name Phelddagrif , an anagram of Garfield, PhD , before it was given to a non-narrative creature.

As part of a Planar Chaos alternate-reality thought experiment, Freyalise was a witch who wreaked havoc on Dominaria, possibly behind the Elemental Invasions that paralleled the Phyrexian Invasion. However, in the Planar Chaos novel few alternate realities were observed and "prime" Freyalise remained a major character.
